text: D10 acceptance verified. Release-local companion and inherited dictionaries show descriptions, units, coded labels and source with the original table values. Same-origin NiiVue 0.69.0 renders bounded single-file scalar NIfTI-1 (raw/gzip, first frame of 4-D) under the existing CSP. The Chromium/PostgreSQL gate sampled actual rendered pixels on two slices of a reflected asymmetric phantom. It also verified qform, invalid orientation, truncated payload, expanded gzip limits and metadata-only denial for both a dictionary table and MRI. Evidence: target/console-backend.1aEmed/receipt.json, tests/console/file-viewers.js. A separate public MNI152 check displayed axial slice 108 of 215. The updated packaged demo on port 8080 served the exact viewer bytes, passed an authenticated dictionary/MRI smoke test, and retained all six catalog IDs and heads.
